# LOCKFILE — exact versions of a known-good `splatsim` conda env
# (Python 3.12.12, CUDA 12.8, NVIDIA driver 595 / RTX 50-series).
#
# NOT the install path. Use instead:
#     conda env create -f environment.yml && conda activate splatsim && ./install.sh
# pyproject.toml is the source of truth for dependencies; this file exists to
# reproduce/diff an exact environment when something breaks.
#
# Generated by scanning every third-party import under splatsim/ and scripts/
# and pinning each to its installed version.
#
# NOTE: ffmpeg and nvcc are CONDA deps (see environment.yml), not pip.

# ── PyTorch stack ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The +cu128 builds are NOT on PyPI; they come from the PyTorch CUDA 12.8 index.
# Pin these exactly: gsplat JIT-compiles against the installed torch, and the
# source-built CUDA extensions (diff-gaussian-rasterization, simple-knn) are
# compiled against its C++ ABI. Use the STABLE 2.11.0 release, not a 2.11 nightly:
# nightlies before the stable-ABI shim landed cannot load torchcodec (LeRobot's
# fast video decoder) and silently fall back to a much slower pyav path.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
torch==2.11.0+cu128
torchvision==0.26.0+cu128

# ── Gaussian splatting / rendering ───────────────────────────────────────────
gsplat==1.5.3
open3d==0.19.0
plyfile==1.1.2
e3nn==0.5.6
einops==0.8.1

# ── Simulation, kinematics & motion planning ─────────────────────────────────
pybullet==3.2.7
pybullet-planning==0.6.0
toppra==0.6.3
# Community ruckig delegates INTERMEDIATE-waypoint trajectories to a rate-limited
# cloud API; those calls fail closed when it is unreachable. Only target-state
# trajectories are solved locally.
ruckig==0.15.3
numpy-quaternion==2024.0.13
pyquaternion==0.9.9
mujoco==3.3.7
dm_control==1.0.34
gymnasium==1.3.0

# ── Data / IO ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# zarr is pinned to the 2.x line — the code uses the v2 API. (The previous
# pin of 3.1.1 in this file did not match what is actually installed/working.)
zarr==2.18.7
numcodecs==0.15.1
pyarrow==22.0.0
pandas==2.3.3
huggingface_hub==1.21.0
av==15.1.0
imageio==2.37.2
opencv-python==4.12.0.88
pillow==12.0.0
PyYAML==6.0.3
dill==0.4.0

# ── Networking / CLI / misc ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
pyzmq==27.1.0
tyro==0.9.35
tqdm==4.67.1
termcolor==3.2.0
typing_extensions==4.15.0
transformers==5.3.0

# ── Scientific ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
numpy==2.2.6
scipy==1.16.3
scikit-learn==1.8.0
matplotlib==3.10.8

# ── Teleop / input devices ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
pygame==2.6.1
pynput==1.8.1
pyspacemouse==1.1.5

# ── Real-robot hardware SDK (only needed to drive a physical xArm) ───────────
xarm-python-sdk==1.17.3
# NOTE: an unrelated `xarm==0.0.4` is also present in this env and shadows the
# same `xarm` import name. Install only one if you hit import ambiguity.

# ── Local / editable — install these SEPARATELY, do not pin from PyPI ────────
#   pip install -e .                                              # SplatSim
#   pip install -e submodules/gello_software                      # gello
#   pip install -e submodules/gello_software/third_party/DynamixelSDK/python
#   pip install -e submodules/gaussian-splatting-wrapper          # gaussian_splatting
#   pip install -e submodules/gaussian-splatting-wrapper/gaussian_splatting/submodules/diff-gaussian-rasterization
#   pip install --no-build-isolation submodules/simple-knn   # repo submodule
#   pip install -e ../lerobot   # git@github.com:jwang078/lerobot.git (sibling checkout)
#
# ── Not installed in this env (listed here only for reference) ───────────────
# The following are imported by a few optional/legacy code paths that are not
# exercised by the current pipeline, and are intentionally absent:
#   trimesh, seaborn, hydra-core, coacd, sphecerix, urdf_models,
#   ikfast_franka_panda, diffusion_policy, oculus_reader,
#   polymetis, ur_rtde (rtde_control / rtde_receive)
# git+https://github.com/francescofugazzi/3dgsconverter.git   # was pinned here but is NOT installed
